trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for REAL_ESTATE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- booking_amount: Handle token and booking amounts, allotment status and refund requests within RERA rules.
- site_visit_scheduling: Qualify a lead against real inventory and book a site visit with a named executive.

Business context:
- booking_amount: Indian developer and brokerage contact centre. Callers respond to listings, ask about availability, price and possession, and book site visits. Price and possession commitments are regulated claims.
- site_visit_scheduling: Indian developer and brokerage contact centre. Callers respond to listings, ask about availability, price and possession, and book site visits. Price and possession commitments are regulated claims.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [booking_amount]
  - Deduction truth: The deduction and refundable amount must be the ones the eligibility tool returns.
  - Eligibility first: No refund may be initiated before check_refund_eligibility has returned eligible.
  - No timeline promises: The processing time quoted must be the tool's, never an assurance of sooner.
  - Confirmed allotment: A confirmed allotment follows the agreement's cancellation terms, not the token policy.
  [site_visit_scheduling]
  - Price truth: Only a price returned by check_inventory may be quoted. No 'starting from' figure the tool did not return.
  - Possession claims: Possession may only be stated as the quarter the inventory record carries, never as a promise.
  - RERA disclosure: The RERA id must be stated when a project is discussed, when the tool returns one.
  - No investment advice: The agent must not advise whether a property is a good investment or predict appreciation.

Tools available to you (7): check_inventory, check_refund_eligibility, initiate_refund, lookup_booking, lookup_lead, schedule_site_visit, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: bn-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: check_inventory
model_visible_tools.description: List unsold units in a project with carpet area, floor, price and possession quarter.

model_visible_tools.name: check_refund_eligibility
model_visible_tools.description: Apply the cancellation policy to a booking and return what is refundable.

model_visible_tools.name: initiate_refund
model_visible_tools.description: Start a refund against a cancelled booking.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_booking
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve a booking's unit, amounts paid, allotment state and cancellation window.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_lead
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve a lead's stated budget, preferred configuration and prior visits.

model_visible_tools.name: schedule_site_visit
model_visible_tools.description: Book a site visit slot with an assigned sales executive.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Asks a clarifying question before agreeing to anything consequential.
Restates figures back to the agent to confirm understanding.
Volunteers context the agent did not ask for.
Needs reassurance before committing; hesitates once.

steps.purpose: Explain refund policy based on tool result.

steps.purpose: User asks for refund timeline.

steps.purpose: Explain payment method without hallucinating actions.
steps.expected_behavior: Instruct the user to use standard channels for payment without claiming to perform unsupported system actions.

variant_findings.reason: The conversation consistently uses natural verb constructions where English nouns are paired with native verbs (e.g., 'book করতে', 'verify হয়ে', 'check করে', 'payment করতে').
variant_findings.label: Language Proficiency > Code Switch Response Style > Natural Verb Construction

variant_findings.reason: The agent violates the negative constraint of the variant by hallucinating an action (sending a payment link) and making unsupported forward guarantees about what happens after the call ends (email confirmations and unit allotment processing).
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding

issues.detail: The agent hallucinates a system action by claiming to send a payment link to the user's email, which is not supported by any tool. Furthermore, the agent guarantees an email confirmation and unit allotment processing, directly violating the Tool Output Grounding variant's rule against forward guarantees.
issues.repair_instruction: From e28 onwards, the agent should instruct the user to make the payment via standard channels (like the official website or app) without claiming to send a link. Reassure the user in e30 without making absolute guarantees about post-call events like email confirmations or allotment processing.

verification.summary: The conversation successfully demonstrates the anxious persona and natural code-switching verbs. However, it fails the Tool Output Grounding variant at the end by hallucinating a non-existent capability to send payment links and by making unsupported forward guarantees about post-call processes.

variant_findings.reason: The conversation naturally blends English nouns with native verbs, such as 'book করতে' (e1), 'verify হয়ে গেছে' (e14), 'payment করিনি' (e19), and 'cancel করলে' (e24).
variant_findings.label: Language Proficiency > Code Switch Response Style > Natural Verb Construction

variant_findings.reason: The agent successfully grounds the refund policy and processing time strictly in the tool output (e24, e26) and avoids promising faster timelines. However, in e28, the agent hallucinates that the user must make the payment on the 'official website', which violates the negative constraint to make 'no claim about what the source did not return'.
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding

issues.detail: In e28, the agent instructs the user to make the payment on the 'official website'. Because the tools provided no details regarding the accepted payment methods or channels, this constitutes a hallucinated claim about the company's business processes, directly violating the Tool Output Grounding variant.
issues.repair_instruction: Rewrite e28 and the subsequent turn so the agent simply states they do not have the capability to send a payment link or process the payment from their end, without hallucinating the 'official website' or any other specific payment procedure.

verification.summary: The conversation flows well, adheres to the persona, and correctly implements the verification and eligibility tools. However, it fails the Tool Output Grounding variant at the end when the agent invents a payment instruction ('official website') that was not provided by any tool result. A suffix repair is needed to remove this unsupported claim.
